name: Saxello ballad
desc: Breathy saxello ballad phrases in Ab major - a new horn color for the jazz shelf: long Ben-Webster-style tones entering right on the downbeat then relaxing behind the beat, scoops via short grace notes, four-bar question-answer form; peak adds double-time bebop turns between the held notes.

root.doc: semitone offset from Ab major home

gain.doc: level (vcsl saxello is quiet - keep high)

code.full: note("<[c5@2 [~ bb4] c5] [[eb5 c5] bb4@2 ~] [ab4 [~ g4] ab4 bb4] [g4@2 [f4 eb4] ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("saxello_vib").clip(1).shape(.45).gain(${gain}).lpf(sine.range(3600,4800).slow(24)).pan(sine.range(.43,.57).slow(20)).room(.45).delay(${haze}).delaytime(.5).delayfeedback(.28).every(8, x=>x.rev()).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: stack(note("<[c5@2 [bb4 c5] [eb5 f5]] [[eb5 c5] bb4 [c5 bb4] [ab4 g4]] [ab4 [g4 ab4] [bb4 c5] [db5 c5]] [[bb4 ab4] g4@2 [f4 eb4]]>").add(note(${root})).s("saxello_vib").clip(.9).shape(.5).gain(${gain}).lpf(sine.range(4000,5200).slow(12)).pan(sine.range(.42,.58).slow(14)), note("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ [eb4 f4]]>").add(note(${root})).s("saxello").clip(.6).shape(.4).gain(${gain}*.5).pan(.6)).room(.42).delay(${haze}*.8).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.25).orbit(5).play()
